principles: Historical DONE status must be stable after later unrelated main changes.
Pre-DONE gates must remain strict and fail closed on stale/tampered evidence.
Read-only diagnostics should distinguish historical closure from current-material revalidation.
drivers: B-da34 red repro shows completed work being misreported as blocked.
The fix must be narrow enough to avoid weakening TEST->DONE.
Future hosts need status output that does not tell them to redo already completed work.

options.name: A: DONE-phase historical snapshot projection
pros: Can be covered by a focused smoke using material drift after completion
cons: Needs careful labeling so current-material revalidation is not confused with historical closure

options.name: B: Refresh B-da34 or stale historical evidence
pros: Would make the current example look green quickly
cons: Does not fix the systemic bug
Mutates history instead of fixing projection semantics

options.name: C: Downgrade all material freshness failures to advisory
cons: Weakens TEST->DONE correctness and could allow stale evidence before completion

rationale: Option A fixes the read-only post-DONE projection bug while preserving strict pre-DONE gates. It lets DONE stories be interpreted against the snapshot that actually completed them, and keeps current-material revalidation as separate/advisory rather than the default blocker.

preMortem.scenario: The fix accidentally weakens TEST->DONE stale evidence checks.
preMortem.trigger: A TEST-phase fixture with stale delivery-check passes DONE unexpectedly.
preMortem.consequence: Proofbound could complete stories with stale evidence.
preMortem.mitigation: Add assertions that TEST-phase closure/gate behavior remains blocking for stale or missing evidence.

preMortem.scenario: review_escalation_status and done_closure disagree for DONE stories.
preMortem.trigger: done_closure passes historical status but review_escalation_status still reports stale current material as blocking.
preMortem.consequence: Future hosts still think completed work needs redo.
preMortem.mitigation: Cover both commands/projections in the regression smoke.

preMortem.scenario: Historical DONE projection hides meaningful current-material drift.
preMortem.trigger: A user wants to know whether a DONE story still validates against current main.
preMortem.mitigation: Label historical closure explicitly and keep current-material revalidation advisory/separate.
